method: GitHub method - exact port of the reference project's RRG (xang1234/stock-screener rrg_service). Input = average RS Rating per weekly bucket (latest MSI snapshot in each Sunday-origin week; groups need >=3 stocks, stocks use their own RS Rating). RS-Ratio X = 100 + 5*z, z = trailing 26-week population z-score of EMA(span 5) of the weekly series (window shrinks to available history). RS-Momentum Y = 100 + 5*z of EMA(span 3) of the 4-week change in RS-Ratio, z over a 13-week window. Both clamped 80..120. Tail = last 8 weeks; series with <12 weekly points are omitted. Provisional while history < 30 weeks.
